what: MACE-MP-0 foundation model (mace-torch, CPU, float64), no fine-tuning, against the stored GPAW PBE references; TB numbers for comparison from the same references

molecules_chno_hessians.note: relaxed with MACE from the GPAW geometry; RMS over internal modes per molecule (cm-1)

conclusion: Without fine-tuning MACE-MP is not better than the TB sets: molecules at the level of xu_chno, and on the carbon coil 11-18 % soft (the systematic softening of universal potentials) with worse bonds than Tang. Not adopted for phonons; tbkit.hybrid keeps the route for any calculator (a fine-tuned potential or DFT).
